Let Wn = A5 ≀· · ·≀A5 be the n-times iterated permutational wreath product of
A5 in its natural action (so Wn acts on 5n points), and let W = lim Wn be the inverse
                                                                      ←−
limit (infinite iterated wreath product of A5 ). Does W contain a finitely generated
dense subgroup of subexponential growth?                                 S. Eberhard
